title: Exact-head reviews start without dependencies because installs are refused on shared mounts

regression.report: Shared read-only dependency mounts refuse the npm ci the review helper always runs

whatHappens: A reviewer checks a pull request head, the dependency install is refused, and tests cannot run.

observations.text: Feedback, 31 Oct 18:57 to 1 Nov 16:21 UTC: 19 reports from 2 agents, repeating on helper 0.1.133. Came with shared dependency mounts (#3188, #3192). No fix on main or open PR.

fixes.text: Reuse or install review dependencies on shared mounts; fix corner opened 1 Nov
